changes.reason: Prevent literal double quotes in helper and database paths; same authorization, helper, scan flags and trigger flow.
Report Continue status, architecture and native breakpoint hit counts; same attach, symbols, callbacks and capture window.

changes.scope: optional complete query output, raw sender-prefix display compatibility, and log callback; defaults preserved
changes.reason: Keep upstream selection, decoding, authorization and capture triggers. full_content avoids the 500-character output summary. Optional sender_from_raw_prefix restores group-card sender from the existing raw prefix before formatting discards it; real_sender_id does not necessarily equal contact.id. Default sender behavior remains unchanged. on_log receives decrypt warnings without patching globals. With the option enabled, a missing raw prefix is shown as unverified rather than guessing from contact.id.

changes.scope: Private console capture and redacted failure diagnostics, including elevated child exit code
changes.reason: Prevent full keys reaching inherited stdout. Preserve actual child exit/timeout and script transcript so crashes and user cancellation are distinguishable. Original process launch, authorization and key parsing are preserved.

changes.scope: Windows cryptography backend compatibility and diagnostic output only
changes.reason: Use Windows CNG PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 with identical candidate, salt, 256000 rounds and 32-byte result; original .NET backend retained on native API unavailability. Synthetic vectors match the original backend byte-for-byte. No changes to process startup, authorization, breakpoints, candidates, scan order or validation criterion. Log only counts, elapsed time and native context errors, never candidate bytes.

hash_format: SHA256 of Git source bytes (LF); .gitattributes enforces LF in vendor on all platforms
